payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute occurrences of t in s via linear scan (complete search) and answer queries with prefix sums.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a sliding window check over all starting positions (complete search) but no permutation/backtracking/bitmask/graph search. Among candidate subtypes, search_permutation_enumeration is the least irrelevant by default, though none accurately describe a simple linear scan and prefix sum.
